theorem_bundle.name: SYMBOLIC_COMPLETE_LOCAL_CHORD_CLASSIFIER_V1
theorem_bundle.statement: For every locally consistent B1 canonical cell and every unordered pair of its seven positions, classification(cell,pair) terminates without materializing the global B1 grammar and returns a sound SOURCE_STATUS, REPRESENTATION_DELTA, EXTENSION_DELTA in {PROVED_NEUTRAL,PROVED_NONNEUTRAL,UNKNOWN}, plus a replay certificate. Unsupported semantic classes return UNKNOWN.
proof: B1 cell validation touches only seven positions, at most 21 adjacency bits, and constant-size finite annotations.
Pair dispatch has finitely many endpoint-type cases.
The only component-message computation in the built-in B-C rule decodes one of 168 sealed four-color message tables and compares at most 16*4 mask/color pairs.
All other built-in rules inspect constant-size masks and local redundancy bits.
Therefore runtime is O(poly(serialized local cell)) and is independent of the size of the full grammar product.

theorem_bundle.name: B_X0_ALREADY_FORBIDDEN_COLOR_NEUTRALITY_V1
theorem_bundle.statement: For dynamic u and fixed X0 identity x_c, the identity distinction is extension-neutral for the final list-coloring relation whenever color c remains forbidden at u without that identity, equivalently c is supplied by chi_S(u) or by another same-color X0 neighbor.
theorem_bundle.consequence: A(u) is identical in the edge/nonedge states; the fixed-color edge contributes no additional coloring restriction.

theorem_bundle.name: B_B_DISJOINT_EXACT_PALETTE_NEUTRALITY_V1
theorem_bundle.statement: If A(u) cap A(v)=empty, the dynamic edge/nonedge distinction uv is extension-neutral for the frozen list-coloring relation.
theorem_bundle.proof: Every list-respecting coloring already satisfies c(u)!=c(v), so the proper-edge constraint is tautological.

theorem_bundle.name: C_X0_REDUNDANT_FIXED_COLOR_NEUTRALITY_V1
theorem_bundle.statement: For representative z in residual component C and fixed identity x_c, if color c remains represented at z through another same-color X0 neighbor after removing the identity edge, then B_C(z) and the whole component list system are unchanged under this one-edge identity distinction; hence mu_C/MIN_BAD/R_C and reconstruction are unchanged.
theorem_bundle.scope_firewall: The theorem concerns only the single identity distinction with all other component coordinates/relations frozen.

theorem_bundle.name: B_C_UNIVERSAL_MASK_EQUALITY_NEUTRALITY_V1
theorem_bundle.statement: Compare source-consistent states differing only by whether dynamic b is anticomplete or complete to residual component C, with the same message mu_C and all other declared boundary structure frozen. If for every F subseteq [4] and every alpha in A(b), mu_C(F)=mu_C(F union {alpha}), then the compiled component boundary relation is identical in both states.
theorem_bundle.proof: For every legal boundary coloring gamma, the complete state changes F_D(gamma) only to F_D(gamma) union {gamma(b)} with gamma(b) in A(b); the universal mask equality therefore gives equal mu_C values. C0 reconstruction supplies a component witness whenever that common value is 1.
theorem_bundle.nonconverse: Failure of universal mask equality is only failure of this sufficient certificate. It does not prove extension nonneutrality without an exact reachable/legal boundary witness.

source_status_policy.OPTIONAL_LOCAL: Neither pair bit is ruled out by the source constraints encoded in the local B1 annotation. This is not a global realizability claim.
source_status_policy.UNKNOWN_GLOBAL_REALIZABILITY: Used for pair families whose opposite bit cannot be certified source-realizable from local annotations alone.
source_status_policy.existential_firewall: Any existential source-valid neutral/nonneutral class outside universal rules requires a source-valid witness or separate realization theorem.

extension_policy.proved_neutral: Only exact direct list/relation proofs or an admitted exact-interface adequacy argument.
extension_policy.proved_nonneutral: Requires a legal/source-valid distinguishing boundary coloring or separately sealed reachability basis.
extension_policy.unknown: Default whenever representation changes but downstream effect is not proved.

conservative_transition_quotient.safe_collapse: Raw distinctions carrying one of the sealed PROVED_NEUTRAL certificates may be collapsed for the corresponding frozen extension observation.
conservative_transition_quotient.unresolved: UNKNOWN distinctions remain unmerged and are not called nonredundant.
conservative_transition_quotient.consequence: A complete proof-distinct nonredundant transition ID system kappa is NOT yet sealed.
